name: jit
description: Enables or disables Just-In-Time compilation of expressions and queries for improved execution speed on complex operations.
symptoms: Increased CPU usage during query planning
Worse latency for simple OLTP queries
JIT compilation failures under resource pressure
tuning_tips: Disable 'jit' for OLTP workloads with short, simple queries; keep enabled for analytical or complex query workloads where JIT overhead is amortized. Monitor CPU and planning time before/after change.
